title: Machine-learning-guided synthesis yields a new blue-emitting perovskite-like single crystal
summary: A high-throughput robotic synthesis and characterization workflow used a convolutional neural network to recognize crystal growth and a machine-learning regressor to guide synthesis conditions. The team reported the first synthesis of (3-PLA)₂PbCl₄, a new perovskite-like single crystal with a direct band gap near 4 eV and strong blue emission. The reported growth conditions were restrictive and required a carefully tuned search.
ai_technology: Convolutional neural network image classifier and machine-learning synthesis-condition regressor

evidence.tested: A high-throughput robotic synthesis and characterization workflow used a convolutional neural network to recognize crystal growth and a machine-learning regressor to guide synthesis conditions.
evidence.unknown: The authors characterize this as a new perovskite-like material and report a laboratory single-crystal synthesis and blue emission. Synthesis conditions were restrictive; the paper does not establish device performance or scale-up.
evidence.ai_role: The CNN classified crystal-growth outcomes from images, and the model trained on high-throughput experimental results selected promising conditions for successive synthesis trials. That feedback-guided sequence enabled the first synthesis of (3-PLA)₂PbCl₄.
